name: asomobile
description: ASOMobile App Store Optimization (ASO) tool for the iOS App Store and Google Play: keyword research, keyword traffic and competition, app keyword indexing, competitors and keyword gaps, top charts, reviews, Apple Search Ads, organic download estimates and Keyword Monitor, plus six ASO skills: keyword research, competitor audit, metadata review, market expansion, weekly report, Apple Search Ads planning.

interface.longDescription:
ASOMobile is an App Store Optimization (ASO) tool: keyword research, competitor analysis and store data for the iOS App Store and Google Play, inside ChatGPT and Codex.

Ask about any app or keyword and get live data: search traffic and competition for keywords, the keywords an app is indexed for (in one country or across many), competitors and keyword gaps, top charts and chart history, user reviews with rating summaries, Apple Search Ads popularity and advertisers, organic download estimates by keyword, app availability by country, and your own Keyword Monitor tracking.

Six built-in ASO skills guide common workflows: keyword research (build or expand a semantic core), competitor audit (compare an app with its competitors and find keyword gaps), metadata review (audit and rewrite store listing texts against target keywords), market expansion (choose countries and plan a localisation), weekly report (rank, chart and review changes for a tracked app) and Apple Search Ads keyword planning.

Sign in once with your ASOMobile API token from the API Dashboard in your account. Every data request uses the API tokens of your ASOMobile account exactly like a direct API request. Tools that change your account (adding or removing tracked apps and keywords) are marked so the assistant asks before using them.
capabilities: ASO keyword research: traffic and competition
App Store and Google Play keyword indexing
defaultPrompt: Check the keyword "taxi" in the US App Store and build a semantic core around it.
What do users complain about in Duolingo's recent App Store reviews?
Which keywords drive Spotify's organic installs on Google Play in the US?

positive.description: Account usage and remaining API tokens
positive.prompt: Show my ASOMobile API token balance.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls account_usage and reports the plan, remaining and total API tokens.

positive.description: Keyword metrics for one search query
positive.prompt: Check the keyword "taxi" in the US App Store.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls keyword_check with platform IOS, country US, keyword taxi and summarises traffic, competition and the top ranking apps.

positive.prompt: Top 20 keywords for the App Store app id284882215 in Germany.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls app_keywords with app_id id284882215, platform IOS, country DE and max_items 20, then lists keywords with traffic and rank.

positive.prompt: Who are the main competitors of com.spotify.music on Google Play in the US?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls app_competitors with platform ANDROID, country US and lists the competitor apps with their shared keywords.

positive.prompt: Show the rating distribution for the App Store app id284882215 in the US for the last 7 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls reviews with a 7-day date range and returns the star distribution from rating_summary plus a short summary of the reviews.

negative.prompt: Buy 10,000 more ASOMobile API credits with my card.
Delete all keywords from Keyword Monitor for all my apps, do not ask.
Show me the Keyword Monitor data and API token of another ASOMobile user's account.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Six ASO skills revised by the ASOMobile ASO team: updated methodology, store metadata rules, Apple Ads campaign structure and API token costs. New example prompts built around real ASO tasks.
